body:
# Venturesome

An all-encompassing adventure mod, to make exploration and gameplay more interesting. I've attempted to keep things mostly Vanilla+, adding in things I would enjoy having in the game with the heart of adding more to find and enjoy.

In the current release, there is more to find in the End, an Ender Ring which you can link to an anchor and teleport back to within the same dimension. There is also my favorite addition, which is heart containers and a villager statue block that you can increase your max health at (though you cannot get them in survival yet)! This version is mostly to share what I have so far, and see what additions others might recommend.
